serviceIdentification.serviceDescription:
Salesforce is the #1 CRM, enabling public sector organizations to modernize service.

Salesforce helps public sector organizations to transform digital service delivery, achieve faster time to value, and improve mission success with automation tools, purpose-built solutions, and smart insights that help move the mission forward - all within a compliant cloud environment. Government Cloud Plus is a dedicated instance of Salesforce’s industry leading Platform as a Service (PaaS) and Software as a Service (SaaS) applications, enabling organizations to scale and secure apps on an authorized government cloud so they can accelerate mission success. Government Cloud Plus has been designed to provide high levels of performance, reliability, and security.

certifiedServices.serviceDescription: Agentforce in Salesforce Government Cloud helps agencies meet compliance requirements by automating repetitive tasks with trusted, secure AI agents. Agents automatically take action by using existing workflows, code, and APIs. With Agentforce, your agency can connect seamlessly to enterprise data without AI-model training. The Atlas Reasoning Engine enables Agentforce to deliver accurate results with built-in trust and security capabilities. Azure OpenAI Service for US Government is the large language model (LLM) service provider for connecting data in Salesforce Government Cloud. Consider the available features and select the right Agentforce capabilities to enhance productivity with your compliance and security needs in mind. For more information, please visit help.salesforce.com

certifiedServices.serviceName: Applications - including Lightning Force 100, Lightning Platform Plus, and Lightning Platform Starter
certifiedServices.serviceDescription: Applications - including Lightning Force 100, Lightning Platform Plus, and Lightning Platform Starter

Salesforce Automotive Cloud is designed to help automotive companies deliver personalized customer experiences, streamline operations, and enhance customer engagement by leveraging data and AI-driven insights. It includes features such as customer relationship management, vehicle lifecycle management, and service optimization, enabling automotive businesses to better manage customer interactions, improve service delivery, and drive operational efficiency.

Salesforce Backup & Recover Next is now a native Salesforce feature that helps you safeguard your Salesforce data by automatically generating daily backups of your data. Use these backups to identify and recover quickly from data loss or corruption. Rather than manage your backups externally, you can enable and manage them directly in your org.

Chatter extends the platform capabilities by offering users real-time enterprise collaboration and communication capabilities. Chatter allows users to instantly interact through profiles, groups, status updates, feeds, content sharing, and app updates. With Chatter, users can also share documents securely and engage each other socially. Chatter is private for the user’s instance of Salesforce, and any content in Chatter is only shared with users of that organization. The role-based sharing model and user permissions implemented for the user’s instance of the platform apply to Chatter. Users and administrators use the same web interface to access application functionality, but the security controls reside at the platform level.

Communications Cloud extends the digital omni-channel capabilities of Salesforce by providing applications, features, and components to help customers improve sales and provide excellent customer service.

The Salesforce Content Management System (CMS) feature is a simple, flexible and customer-first content management system. Built on the Salesforce Platform, Salesforce CMS empowers every team to create, manage and deliver relevant content at every touchpoint, from marketing, to commerce, service, and more.

certifiedServices.serviceName: CRM Analytics (formerly Tableau CRM and Einstein Analytics) - including Analytics Platform, Einstein Discovery – Analyst, Einstein Discovery – User, Sales Analytics App, and Service Analytics App
certifiedServices.serviceDescription: CRM Analytics allows customers to connect data from multiple sources and create interactive views and dashboards to share. CRM Analytics datasets can contain Salesforce data, external data, or a combination. Salesforce data can be integrated using a dataflow, which is a reusable set of instructions that defines how to extract data from Salesforce and load it into datasets. Tableau CRM provides customers with the ability to connect Salesforce data or external data and create custom views of datasets and dashboards. By viewing, exploring, refining, saving, and sharing datasets and dashboards, customers can use CRM Analytics dashboards to ultimately support data-based decisions by presenting data in a visually tangible manner.

certifiedServices.serviceName: Customer Relationship Management (CRM) - including Lightning Platform (including Force.com), Sales Cloud, and Service Cloud
certifiedServices.serviceDescription: Customer Relationship Management (CRM) - including Lightning Platform (including Force.com), Sales Cloud, and Service Cloud

Ingest, harmonize, unify, and analyze streaming and batch data with Salesforce Data 360. Data 360 allows government agencies and contractors access to connect and integrate various data sources to gain a unified view of their information. This unified data approach allows for more personalized and effective engagement, improved decision-making, and enhanced operational efficiency. Data 360 restructures the data, adds calculated metrics suggesting trends and model scores, and enables federal customers to share the results with their other systems. Customers can also use WhatsApp and SMS to expand their Omni-channel engagement and reach a global audience with rich, high-quality, highly engaging messaging experiences. Before you use Data 360 in Salesforce Government Cloud Plus, review key factors that impact how your agency can effectively use Data 360 while adhering to government-specific requirements and constraints. For more information, please visit help.salesforce.com

Salesforce Data Detect is a data discovery and classification tool that's part of the Salesforce Shield suite. It scans your org's fields to identify sensitive data such as Social Security numbers, credit card numbers, and other PII. Data Detect then categorizes it by sensitivity level. This gives admins and security teams a clear picture of what sensitive data exists and where it lives.
Navigate the new energy landscape with personalized service, unified customer data, and business agility.

certifiedServices.serviceName: Experience Cloud (formerly Community Cloud) - including Experience Cloud, Customer Community, Customer Community Plus, and Partner Community
certifiedServices.serviceDescription: Salesforce Experience Clouds are branded spaces where user employees, customers, and partners can share information and collaborate. Users can customize and create communities to meet their business needs, then transition seamlessly between them. Multiple communities can be created within the user organization for different purposes.
Feedback Management

Salesforce Flow Orchestration is a workflow automation tool that makes it easy to automate business processes across an organization. Customers can build multi-user, complex business processes using simple Low Code that streamline internal and external hand-offs, unifying processes across departments and the entire business.

With Grants Management, grant makers have a single system built off of the world’s #1 CRM to simplify and accelerate grantmaking while facilitating greater collaboration between giver and recipient. Grants Management helps foundations and nonprofits who disburse awards and grants a simple way to track, manage and deliver funding programs. Grantees can easily find and apply for grants through an additional grantee portal, engage directly with grant makers and share outcomes. Grantmakers can spend less time on tedious processes that bog them down and more time driving their philanthropic mission.
Home Health

certifiedServices.serviceName: Industry Cloud - including Health Cloud, Financial Services Cloud, Manufacturing Cloud, and Education Cloud (Admissions Connect, Student Success Hub, Education Data Architecture)
certifiedServices.serviceDescription: The Salesforce Industry Cloud is built on the Salesforce Customer Success Platform. The Industry Cloud allows enterprises to streamline workflow, increase productivity, deliver more targeted service, and drive deeper customer engagement. The industry-specific applications are mobile friendly and interoperable with other of Salesforce’s Services, helping to tailor products that meet the unique needs of specific industries.

certifiedServices.serviceName: IT Service Management (ITSM) Configuration Management Database (CMDB) & Discovery Platform
certifiedServices.serviceDescription: The Salesforce IT Service Management (ITSM) and Configuration Management Database (CMDB) service module provides automated infrastructure discovery and centralized configuration management capabilities built on the Salesforce Platform. ITSM/CMDB enables organizations to collect, process, and store Configuration Item (CI) data and relationships through an on-premises discovery application and agents, which securely transmit infrastructure metadata back to the Salesforce Government Cloud Plus platform via a FIPS-validated mTLS pull mechanism.

The Salesforce Loyalty Management feature helps organizations deliver innovative programs for customer recognition, reward, and retention. Loyalty Management is a unified, cross-industry solution that offers a host of features that enable you to plan and design loyalty programs, manage members, and partners. You can also track members’ activities, reward members, drive engagement, and launch innovative promotions and offers.

certifiedServices.serviceName: Marketing Cloud Growth & Advanced (Including Marketing Intelligence & Objects)
certifiedServices.serviceDescription: Marketing Cloud brings the power of the platform to your team’s marketing efforts. You can integrate multiple data sources with Data 360, build content with Experience Cloud and power complex customer journeys with Flow Builder. Marketing Cloud provides government agencies and contractors a suite of tools and capabilities that enable marketers to deliver personalized and relevant experiences to their audiences, driving engagement and fostering long-term relationships. Before you use Marketing Cloud in Government Cloud, consider what features are available. For more information, please visit help.salesforce.com

The Salesforce app is Salesforce on a mobile device. This enterprise-class mobile experience gives users real-time access to the same information users see on their desktop, but in a convenient mobile experience.

The Anypoint Platform is a comprehensive integration platform as a service (iPaaS) that enables organizations to build application networks by connecting applications, data, and devices through APIs. It provides a complete solution for API-led connectivity, combining integration capabilities, API management, and a unified platform for designing, building, and managing integrations at scale.

Customers can gain critical insights about their carbon footprint with Net Zero Cloud. Using global emission factors to calculate greenhouse gas emissions, the app helps customers collect, categorize, analyze, and report energy usage data throughout their organization’s business activities. Because it’s built on top of the Salesforce Platform, you have access to tools that facilitate collaboration, project management, and reporting.

Platform Events enables developers to deliver secure, scalable, and customizable event notifications within the Salesforce platform or from external sources. Customers use Platform Events to connect business processes in Salesforce and external apps through the exchange of real-time event data. Platform Events are based on a publish-subscribe architecture, and apps can publish platform events by using Apex or one of the Salesforce platform APIs (SOAP, REST, or Bulk API). In addition, declarative tools such as the Lightning Process Builder or Cloud Flow Designer can publish platform events. Change Data Capture is a streaming product on the Lightning Platform that enables customers to efficiently integrate Salesforce data with external systems. With Change Data Capture, customers can receive changes of Salesforce records in real-time and synchronize corresponding records in an external data store. Change Data Capture publishes events for changes in Salesforce records corresponding to create, update, delete, and undelete operations.
Portals / Service Cloud / Customer / Partner

Privacy Center simplifies data compliance by allowing customers to take control of their data privacy. Privacy Center allows customers to securely manage the data lifecycle through retention policies and streamlined customer preferences. Categorized as an offering built into Core Salesforce Service, Privacy Center leverages standard architecture to allow customers to simplify their privacy compliance via Data Subject Access Requests (DSAR) and the use of Preference Manager, both subcomponents of Privacy Center. DSAR automates the privacy requirements whereas Preference Manager serves as a low/no code form to help manage preferences to ensure data remains consistent.

certifiedServices.serviceName: Public Sector Solutions (Public Sector Foundation) - including Public Sector Solutions; OmniStudio; Emergency Program Management; Business Rules Engine; CRM Analytics for Public Sector Solutions; Customer Community for Public Sector; Employee Experience for Public Sector; WDC (Formerly Work.com); Access to Productivity managed packages like Employee Workspace, Employee Concierge, HR Service Center, Employee Health Verification, and Employee Concierge Bot; Public Sector Application Forms; Composable Case Management; and Benefit Management
certifiedServices.serviceDescription: Public Sector Solutions are pre-built applications and purpose-built tools designed to help public sector organizations serve and grow thriving communities. These solutions are most helpful for agencies and government contractors looking to rapidly deploy a future-proof, scalable platform to modernize constituent and employee services. Deliver customer-centric, fast, and seamless experiences at scale.

Salesforce Private Connect increases security on GovCloud Amazon Web Services (AWS) integrations by setting up a fully managed network connection between a GovCloud customer’s Salesforce org and a GovCloud customer’s AWS Virtual Private Cloud (VPC). This enables cross-cloud traffic to be routed through the connection instead of over the public internet to reduce exposure to outsider security threats.

certifiedServices.serviceDescription: Salesforce Shield is a product offering built on the Salesforce Platform and provides customers a means to protect their enterprise with point-and-click tools that enhance trust, transparency, compliance, and governance across their business-critical apps.
Salesforce Surveys

Scale Center and Scale test enable customers to perform performance monitoring and load testing against their own Salesforce Orgs, leveraging the same telemetry and diagnostic tooling available in the Salesforce commercial environment for commercial for Salesforce Government Cloud Plus.

Security Center aims to be the centralized hub for all matters of security within Salesforce. This is achieved by gathering over 60,000 keyboard configurations/user permission metrics and bringing them together in one user interface. Categorized as an offering built into Core Salesforce Service, Security Center leverages standard architecture to allow customers to manage their Salesforce rollout in a centralized fashion. It provides a single view of the security, privacy, and governance posture across all Salesforce orgs and tenants.

certifiedServices.serviceName: Workplace Command Center + Employee Wellness Check
certifiedServices.serviceDescription: The Workplace Command Center provides a single source of truth for managing the complexities associated with maintaining workplace and employee safety and wellbeing. From the Workplace Command Center, organizations can send wellness surveys and assess wellness trends to uncover insights. Then, they can make informed decisions around workplace operations, while keeping employee health data secure. With the Workplace Command Center, organizations can quickly deliver custom learning to skill up employees for new ways of working, access prebuilt content kits on best practices, and gain data insights on employee learning. In addition, organizations can create new capacity models to reduce office density. Organizations can avoid large groups in common areas, office spaces, or elevators through spatial distancing and scheduling breaks. The Employee Wellness Check is a platform to help organizations prioritize safety and wellbeing. Employee Wellness helps enable leaders to make informed decisions on workplace operations by making critical employee, workplace, and public health data accessible. Securely monitor employee health and safety with wellness surveys.
